data.narrative:
Atom Computing is a Series B semiconductor company that has raised $300M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public comparables in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including same-stage companies like Positron AI ($1.0B) and adjacent-stage peers such as Etched ($5.0B) and d-Matrix ($2.0B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $300M raised proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yields $570M. Peer-median analysis across the 5-company same-sector cohort (range: $529M to $11.0B) produces $2.0B. Public-comparable anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not available; while the 3-ticker Semiconductor peer set (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) trades at a 21.4x price-to-sales median, private companies rarely disclose sufficient revenue detail. Public-comp triangulation was therefore excluded from synthesis.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $484M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The wide spread reflects material stage and maturity dispersion within the peer set; SambaNova's $11.0B valuation at Series A versus DEEPX at $529M at Series C underscores sector volatility. Key uncertainties include Atom's revenue trajectory, technology differentiation relative to peers, and the sustainability of current private-market valuations in semiconductors.
